children: Patil’s three-year term begins 21 September, bringing 36 years of experience across industrial technology, finance and business transformation
Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited has appointed Ajay Patil as Joint Managing Director for a three-year term from 21 September 2026 to 20 September 2029.

Patil brings 36 years of experience in business strategy, profitable growth, corporate governance, capital allocation, enterprise transformation, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures and risk management.

He most recently served as Global Chief Financial Officer at RSB Transmission India, a Bain Capital portfolio company. His career also includes senior regional and global leadership roles at Cummins, Honeywell and Eaton, with responsibilities spanning Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, the Americas and global operations.
Patil has also been associated with the School of Sustainability at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. He is a Cost and Management Accountant and holds a master’s degree in commerce.
Kirloskar Ferrous said the appointment will strengthen its leadership team and support its priorities around business transformation and sustainable growth.
